title: Bound aggregate Multi-Site manual health probes
implementation: Added a ten-second linked aggregate budget for manual health probe batches across all upstreams of a Site.
Added a safe site_health_probe_timeout RFC 7807 response and bounded Thai browser recovery copy.
Preserved caller cancellation and per-upstream timeout/error categorization.

verification.tddRed: Initial test build failed because SiteHealthProbeBudget did not exist.
verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory color findings only

boundary: Live aggregate timeout execution against multiple real upstreams remains externally unverified.
